dedupe_keys.name: glenigan construction project leads and market data uk and ireland

description: Glenigan provides construction sales leads, marketing data and market analysis for the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland. On 26 September 2026 its search showed 597,668 live construction projects, filterable by region, stage (early planning, plans approved, pre-tender, tenders and contract awarded), sector (community and amenity, education, health, hotel and leisure, industrial, infrastructure, offices, private and social housing, retail and utilities) and project value. Glenigan says 160 dedicated researchers gather its data and that planning data from the Planning Portal give insight up to three weeks earlier. Coverage: construction projects in the UK regions and the Republic of Ireland. Access: subscription with a free trial. Licence: commercial; paid. Caveats: data are proprietary and oriented to sales leads, not research. Simulation uses are pipelines of planned buildings by sector and stage for future stock and demand scenarios. Related records: UK PlanIt and the Planning Data platform for England.
